blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water has expanded its sewer network to 500.08 kilometers as of July 2026, marking a significant milestone in its continuing efforts to improve sewer services and protect public health and the environment across its service area. The milestone reflects Manila Water’s long-term commitment to expanding access to sewer services and supporting cleaner waterways through sustained investments in sanitation infrastructure. Sewer lines collect and convey wastewater from homes, establishments, and communities for proper treatment before safe discharge to the environment.
